video.title: Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft Pick 6 - Must Draft Players Inside

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team, 9-category Yahoo mock draft from pick 6 and takes Jayson Tatum first. His team after that: Jamal Murray, Kyrie Irving, Deni Avdija, Zach Edey, Julius Randle, De'Aaron Fox, Brandon Podziemski, Jakob Poeltl, Jeremiah Fears, Miles Bridges, Grayson Allen, Collin Gillespie and Aaron Nesmith. He reacts to other teams' picks along the way. He thinks AJ Dybantsa and Cason Wallace went too early, says Zubac and Cam Johnson were good value, and notes that Miles Bridges slides in every draft. He says he is getting higher on Damian Lillard and Zach LaVine and less worried about Kyrie's ACL. He warns that big preseason numbers can be inflated when other players sit out. His projections put his team second, behind the team that picked third.

rules.text: Do not copy what a mock draft does at a given pick. Every draft is different. Use mocks to see different valuations and to learn how to pivot.
rules.quote: what I want you to take out of mockdrafts is not following a pattern of what happens at a particular pick

rules.text: When you pick at the turn, you have to take some players earlier than their usual spot.
rules.quote: when you're on the turn, you do have to make some earlier picks

rules.text: Be careful with big preseason numbers. Stats have to go to someone, so when many players sit out, someone puts up big numbers.
rules.quote: Stats do need to be accumulated. So, if everyone's out, somebody will do it.

rules.text: Players taken in the second round range are close to interchangeable, so take the one who fits your build.
rules.quote: There's a lot of interchangeability with these guys.

rules.text: Watch your category totals during the draft and fill weak spots. He looks for a big man when his FG% is weak and for assists when he needs them.
